hunks.sol: “I must politely decline. I already have a lover I’ve been with for many years.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve seen all your cards. Now it is my turn.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve seen all your cards. Now it’s my turn.”

hunks.sol: With that quiet murmur, the Western Heaven Demon Lord stepped forward. A suffocating aura rippled behind him like wings.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s martial arts had reached a realm far beyond what I had imagined.

hunks.sol: I could almost hear a bell ringing somewhere to announce the start of round two.

hunks.baseline: But this wasn’t a boxing match that ended after twelve rounds. There were no spectators shouting cheers and groans, and no staff to throw in a towel.
hunks.sol: But this wasn’t a boxing match that ended after twelve rounds. There were no spectators to cheer or groan, no staff to throw in the towel.

hunks.baseline: This was a match that ended only when someone staked their life—nothing but their life.
hunks.sol: This match would end only when one of us staked his life—nothing less.

hunks.sol: The cold spear shaft settled into my grip. I drew a deep breath and leveled the spearhead at the Western Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord extended one foot.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord kicked off the ground.

hunks.baseline: His vanished figure reappeared in the air above my head.
hunks.sol: His vanished figure reappeared in midair above my head.

hunks.baseline: The sensation of my fine hairs standing on end reached me as I leaned my body backward.
hunks.sol: Every hair on my body stood on end as I leaned backward.

hunks.baseline: The heel of his foot grazed my nose by the narrowest margin before slamming into the ground. The floor caved in, and fragments of stone flew in every direction.
hunks.sol: His heel missed the bridge of my nose by a hair and slammed into the ground. The floor caved in, sending fragments of stone flying in every direction.

hunks.baseline: Blood trickled from the bridge of my nose, sliced by the wind pressure, but I wasn’t given even a moment to wipe it away.
hunks.sol: Blood trickled from the bridge of my nose where the wind pressure had sliced it, but I wasn’t given even a moment to wipe it away.

hunks.baseline: Ink-black Sword Energy rained down from every direction. It slashed, cut, and swung without discrimination at my waist, chest, and stomach.
hunks.sol: Ink-black Sword Energy rained down from every direction, slashing and sweeping toward my waist, chest, and stomach without distinction.

hunks.baseline: Attacks I could never have dodged in the past.
hunks.sol: They were attacks I could never have dodged in the past.

hunks.baseline: Within the slowed-down world, I sensed the Sword Energy shooting toward me.
hunks.sol: In the slowed world, I sensed the Sword Energy hurtling toward me.

hunks.baseline: I could picture where that destructive energy would move and how I needed to move to evade it.
hunks.sol: I could picture where that destructive energy was headed and how I needed to move to evade it.

hunks.baseline: I dodged some attacks and knocked others away with my spear. Thick clouds of dust rose everywhere, along with craters that looked like they belonged in a war movie.
hunks.sol: I dodged some attacks and knocked others aside with my spear. Thick clouds of dust billowed into the air, and craters like something out of a war movie pockmarked the ground.

hunks.baseline: Ink-black Sword Force, casting a dull light, shot out through the dust cloud. With a steady gaze, the Western Heaven Demon Lord brought his sword down along a diagonal line.
hunks.sol: Ink-black Sword Force gleaming with a murky light burst through the dust cloud. His gaze calm and steady, the Western Heaven Demon Lord brought his sword down in a diagonal slash.

hunks.baseline: I had no way of knowing what martial art it was or what form he was using.
hunks.sol: I had no way of knowing what martial art or form he was using.

hunks.baseline: If I backed down here, the only thing left for me was death.
hunks.sol: If I backed down here, all that awaited me was death.

hunks.baseline: *I have to strike back.*
hunks.sol: *I have to meet it head-on.*

hunks.baseline: Every muscle in my body drew taut like a bowstring. My foot shot forward first, followed by my waist, which had bent as far back as possible. Rotational force flowed through my shoulder and arm and poured into the spearhead.
hunks.sol: Every muscle in my body drew taut like a bowstring. My foot shot forward first, and my waist, bent as far back as it could go, snapped forward. The rotational force flowed through my shoulder and arm and poured into the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: It was a concentration of energy far too massive to be called Spear Energy.
hunks.sol: It was a concentration of energy far too massive to be called mere Spear Energy.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead, wreathed in blue flames, surged forward. It burned through the air and devoured the dust cloud as it shot toward a single man.
hunks.sol: The spearhead surged forward, wreathed in blue flames. It burned through the air and devoured the dust cloud as it hurtled toward a single man.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes widened. At the same time, his blade trembled, and an even larger mass of Sword Force erupted from it.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes widened. At the same time, his blade trembled, and an even greater mass of Sword Force erupted from it.

hunks.baseline: The next instant, blue flames and black darkness collided.
hunks.sol: The next instant, blue flame and black darkness collided.

hunks.baseline: With a roar unlike anything I had ever heard, everything within a radius of over a hundred feet shattered and exploded.
hunks.sol: A roar unlike anything I had ever heard erupted as everything within a radius of over a hundred feet shattered and exploded.

hunks.baseline: In the middle of it all, one person stood tall.
hunks.sol: Amid it all, one man remained standing.

hunks.baseline: Even my full-powered One Annihilation wasn’t enough.
hunks.sol: Even my full-powered One Annihilation hadn’t worked.

hunks.baseline: At my dejected expression, the Western Heaven Demon Lord shook his head. Blood was running down from his shoulder. That was all One Annihilation had left behind.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord shook his head at my dejected expression. Blood ran down from his shoulder. That was all One Annihilation had left behind.

hunks.baseline: “There is no need to be disappointed. It was a sufficiently powerful form. For a moment, it was enough to make my heart turn cold.”
hunks.sol: “There’s no need to be disappointed. It was a sufficiently powerful form. For a moment, it even sent a chill through my heart.”

hunks.baseline: “If I hadn’t wasted my strength from the beginning and had launched that strike just now… could I have killed you?”
hunks.sol: “If I hadn’t wasted my strength earlier and had opened with that strike… could I have killed you?”

hunks.baseline: After thinking it over carefully, the Western Heaven Demon Lord answered.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord considered it carefully before answering.

hunks.baseline: “I believe you could have taken one of my arms. Perhaps even more than that. But you would have died.”
hunks.sol: “I believe you could have taken one of my arms. Perhaps even more than that. But you would have been the one to die.”

hunks.baseline: “I think it is time to finish this.”
hunks.sol: “I think it’s time to end this.”

hunks.baseline: It no longer surprised me. Sword Force surged up like water from an inexhaustible spring and was swung like a whip.
hunks.sol: It didn’t even surprise me anymore. Sword Force surged like water from an inexhaustible spring and lashed toward me like a whip.

hunks.baseline: I gritted my teeth as extreme weakness washed over me from the expenditure of my internal energy.
hunks.sol: I gritted my teeth as the drain on my internal energy left me weak to the point of collapse.

hunks.baseline: “It’s not over yet.”
hunks.sol: “It’s… not over yet.”

hunks.baseline: I pulled up every bit of internal energy I had left and unleashed the Fire Dragon Divine Spear.
hunks.sol: I drew up every last bit of internal energy I had and unleashed the Fire Dragon Divine Spear.

hunks.baseline: Unlike before, the blue flames were visibly smaller. They shot toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s exposed neck.
hunks.sol: The blue flames were visibly smaller than before. They shot toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s exposed throat.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, I met the unwavering gaze of the Western Heaven Demon Lord and realized it.
hunks.sol: The next instant, I met his unwavering gaze and realized it.

hunks.sol: By the time the realization flashed through my mind, it was already too late. The Sword Force that had seemed poised to cut me down abruptly changed course in midair and struck the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: A roar like the sky splitting apart rang out. I gritted my teeth as I clung to the violently shaking spear shaft.
hunks.sol: A roar like the sky splitting apart rang out. I clenched my teeth and held on to the spear shaft as it bucked violently in my hands.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Force swung toward me, my ankles already driven deep into the ground.
hunks.sol: My ankles were already buried deep in the ground when the Sword Force swept toward me.

hunks.baseline: Terrifying energy flew in from thirty-six directions centered on my body.
hunks.sol: Terrifying energy hurtled in from thirty-six directions around me.

hunks.baseline: With every nerve in my body standing on end, I swung my spear like a madman.
hunks.sol: Every nerve in my body screamed as I swung my spear like a madman.

hunks.baseline: Every time I blocked a strike, my body staggered and my breath caught in my throat.
hunks.sol: My body staggered and my breath caught with every strike I deflected.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t a problem of speed or strength.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t a matter of speed or strength.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s martial arts were in a distant realm I could never reach, and the terrifying internal energy transmitted through my spear shook the inside of my body.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s martial arts occupied a distant realm beyond my reach, and the terrifying internal energy transmitted through my spear battered me from within.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell…!*
hunks.sol: *This is fucking insane…!*

hunks.baseline: Blood sprayed between my clenched teeth. My torn hands had been covered in blood for some time already.
hunks.sol: Blood sprayed through my clenched teeth. My torn palms had long since been drenched in blood.

hunks.baseline: I squeezed out every last bit of strength and swung my spear at the ink-black Sword Force cleaving toward my chest.
hunks.sol: I squeezed out every last ounce of strength and swung my spear at the ink-black Sword Force cleaving toward my chest.

hunks.baseline: Heavenly Strike.
hunks.sol: *Heavenly Strike.*

hunks.baseline: But unlike the first time, the fire dragon’s claw was pitifully weak, and the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s ink-black Sword Force had not lost even a fraction of its power.
hunks.sol: But unlike before, the fire dragon’s claw was pitifully weak, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s ink-black Sword Force hadn’t lost even a fraction of its power.

hunks.baseline: What I saw was the underground prison shaking as though struck by an earthquake, with thick clouds of dust filling the surroundings.
hunks.sol: Before me, the underground prison shook as though caught in an earthquake, thick clouds of dust filling the air.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t see the Western Heaven Demon Lord ahead of me, to either side, or in the air.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord was nowhere to be seen. Not ahead of me, to either side, or above.

hunks.baseline: Then there was only one answer.
hunks.sol: That left only one possibility.

hunks.baseline: Two sounds rang out at the same time.
hunks.sol: Two sounds rang out at once.

hunks.baseline: The heat of the Flame Divine Palm burned through the air, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s palm had already reached my chest.
hunks.sol: The heat of the Flame Divine Palm burned through the air, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s palm struck my chest.

hunks.baseline: My vision turned white, followed by the pain of my heart meridians snapping apart one strand at a time. I swallowed the blood surging into my throat and righted my flying body.
hunks.sol: My vision went white. Then came the agony of my heart meridian tearing apart strand by strand. I swallowed the blood surging up my throat and regained control of my body as I was hurled backward.

hunks.baseline: “That was amazing. I mean it.”
hunks.sol: “That was remarkable. I mean it.”

hunks.baseline: It was instinct.
hunks.sol: It was pure instinct.

hunks.baseline: At the quiet voice coming from beside me, my arm moved on its own. The hand blade shooting toward the back of my neck struck my forearm instead.
hunks.sol: At the quiet voice that suddenly came from beside me, my arm moved on its own. The hand blade shooting toward the back of my neck struck my forearm instead.

hunks.baseline: Pain surged through me with the sound of a bone being forced out of place. Then the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s foot, swung like a whip, drove into my side.
hunks.sol: Pain flooded through me with the sound of bone shifting out of place. Then the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s foot lashed out like a whip and buried itself in my side.

hunks.baseline: After smashing through the rock and embedding me in the wall, the Western Heaven Demon Lord slowly walked toward me.
hunks.sol: I smashed through the rock and became embedded in the wall. The Western Heaven Demon Lord slowly walked toward me.

hunks.baseline: The emotions in his eyes were admiration and delight.
hunks.sol: Admiration and delight filled his eyes.

hunks.baseline: I spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm and answered.
hunks.sol: I spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm.

hunks.baseline: “You may be proud of yourself. You lasted more than three hundred moves against me while I was fighting at full strength.”
hunks.sol: “You should be proud. You lasted more than three hundred moves against me while I was fighting at full strength.”

hunks.baseline: “You do not seem particularly happy, so let me put it another way. What if the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and her Elders had lasted more than five hundred moves?”
hunks.sol: “You don’t seem particularly happy, so let me put it another way. What if I told you the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and her Elders lasted more than five hundred moves?”

hunks.baseline: “No. Not at all.”
hunks.sol: “Nope. Still not happy.”

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord looked genuinely unable to understand. I tossed him a single answer.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord looked genuinely baffled. I tossed him a curt answer.

hunks.baseline: Even if someone lasted three hundred moves, five hundred moves, or a thousand moves, if they lost the fight, the only thing left for the loser in the end was death.
hunks.sol: Three hundred moves, five hundred moves, a thousand moves—it didn’t matter. If you lost the fight, all that awaited the loser was death.

hunks.baseline: I suppose I was no different.
hunks.sol: Neither was I, probably.

hunks.baseline: Blood seeped through my parted lips.
hunks.sol: Blood seeped between my parted lips.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to stand up as casually as the Western Heaven Demon Lord had earlier, but my body was in no condition for that.
hunks.sol: I wanted to get up as casually as the Western Heaven Demon Lord had earlier, but my body was in no condition for that.

hunks.baseline: I had really been beaten to hell. No wonder breathing had felt difficult for a while.
hunks.sol: I’d really taken one hell of a beating. No wonder breathing had been difficult for a while now.

hunks.baseline: Breathing heavily, I used White Flame as a cane to pull myself upright.
hunks.sol: Panting, I planted White Flame like a cane and dragged myself upright.

hunks.baseline: At the sight of me, the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes lit up.
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes lit up.

hunks.baseline: “That must also be the power of supernatural powers. Show me. Quickly. Quickly!”
hunks.sol: “That must also be the power of those supernatural powers. Show me. Quickly! Quickly!”

hunks.baseline: I leveled my spear at the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who was getting excited like a child.
hunks.sol: I leveled my spear at the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who was practically bouncing with excitement like a child.

hunks.baseline: And that was the entirety of what I did.
hunks.sol: And that was all I did.

hunks.baseline: “What are you doing? Aren’t you coming in?”
hunks.sol: “What are you waiting for? Come at me.”

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord stared at me with incomprehension and asked,
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord stared at me in confusion.

hunks.baseline: “I’m good with my body, but I’m hopeless with my head. I’m such a dumbass that I even failed the Level Eight Hanja exam.[^1] But then I came across the term ‘supernatural powers’ in a martial-arts novel. I didn’t know what it meant, so I looked it up.”
hunks.sol: “I’m good with my body, but hopeless with my head. I’m such a dumbass that I even failed the Level Eight Hanja exam.[^1] Then I came across the term ‘supernatural powers’ in a martial-arts novel. I didn’t know what it meant, so I looked it up.”

hunks.baseline: Even if I explained it like this, he probably wouldn’t understand half of what I was saying.
hunks.sol: He probably couldn’t understand half of what I was saying.

hunks.baseline: My vision wavered. Every time I exhaled, my lungs prickled as though they were being stabbed with needles, and the spear shaft that had always felt light now seemed like a boulder weighing ten thousand geun.
hunks.sol: My vision wavered. Every breath made my lungs prickle as though needles were stabbing into them, and the spear shaft that had always felt so light now weighed as much as a ten-thousand-geun boulder.

hunks.baseline: But still…
hunks.sol: Even so…

hunks.baseline: “‘Supernatural powers.’ Mysterious beings or phenomena that are difficult to explain through reason. That’s what it meant.”
hunks.sol: “‘Supernatural powers.’ Mysterious beings or phenomena that can’t be explained through reason. That’s what it meant.”

hunks.baseline: I neither staggered nor collapsed. I simply stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord and continued speaking slowly.
hunks.sol: I neither staggered nor collapsed. I simply stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord and continued slowly.

hunks.baseline: “What’s so special about supernatural powers? A bastard who keeps fighting even after being reduced to this state—that’s supernatural powers.”
hunks.sol: “What’s so special about supernatural powers? A bastard who keeps fighting even after he’s been reduced to this—that’s supernatural powers.”

hunks.baseline: Physical condition? It was a miracle that I could still stand.
hunks.sol: Physical condition? It was a miracle I could still stand.

hunks.baseline: Now that everything had escaped as if from Pandora’s box, the one thing I had left was not hope.
hunks.sol: Now that everything had flown out like the contents of Pandora’s box, the one thing left inside me wasn’t hope.

hunks.baseline: Hope could make people stand back up, but it could also make them weak.
hunks.sol: Hope could make someone rise again, but it could also make them weak.

hunks.baseline: But as long as that grit remained—as long as I still had the will to fight until the very end—I would not fall.
hunks.sol: But as long as that grit remained—as long as I still possessed the will to fight to the bitter end—I wouldn’t fall.

hunks.baseline: I gathered all the internal energy I had left. A fistful of qi desperately surged toward the spearhead.
hunks.sol: I gathered every last scrap of internal energy. The meager handful of qi flowed unsteadily toward the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: A faint wisp of Spear Energy lit up the darkness like the glow of a firefly.
hunks.sol: A faint wisp of Spear Energy lit the darkness like a firefly.

hunks.baseline: “Quit spouting bullshit and come at me, you bastard with a supernatural-powers fetish.”
hunks.sol: “Quit spouting bullshit and come at me, you supernatural-powers-loving bastard.”

hunks.baseline: After countless emotions passed across his face, his gaze settled into a deep solemnity.
hunks.sol: Countless emotions passed across his face. When they were gone, only a pair of deeply solemn eyes remained.
